svg.title: DevOps engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as devops engineer, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: Three staggered build, test and release stages are linked in a continuous deployment cycle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face.
